name: selfit closet cutout imagegen test set
purpose: Generate synthetic but realistic images to test garment detection, semantic category assignment, mask quality, cutout quality, and review/rejected routing. Expanded with long-tail user-upload, source-platform, demographic, cultural, accessory, framing, duplicate, and hard-negative cases.

image_generation_defaults.aspect_ratio: 4:5 or 3:4 vertical unless the case says top-down flatlay
image_generation_defaults.avoid: brand logos, watermarks, celebrity faces, extra unrelated garments unless requested by the case

groups.name: standard_single_item_catalog
groups.goal: Clean baseline product images that should be easy to cut out.

cases.title: white background short sleeve t-shirt
cases.acceptance: One top item, clean outline, no background residue.
cases.imagegen_prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: closet cutout test image. Primary request: a single plain short sleeve t-shirt laid flat on a pure white studio background. Subject: cotton t-shirt, front view, sleeves naturally spread, no model, no hanger. Composition/framing: centered product catalog shot with generous padding, full garment visible. Lighting/mood: soft even studio lighting, minimal shadow. Constraints: no logo, no text, no watermark, no other objects.
